name: auth-cross-origin-403

graded_by.test: core/internal/httpapi/httpapi_test.go — TestCrossOriginStateChangesAreRefused: POST /auth/login and POST /auth/logout with a foreign Origin header are refused 403 forbidden, before a credential is read or a login ends

description: A browser write from a foreign origin to POST /auth/login or POST /auth/logout is refused 403 forbidden (the core already does; now declared): the request's Origin header is not the broker's own, so a page elsewhere cannot log a browser in or out. A fixture cannot send an Origin header, so the core's own test grades it.
